Subject: Pilot kickoff: model shortlist guidance + traffic signal

Hi Diego / Monica —

Thanks again for the demo today. We want to lock down the pilot model candidates and a rough hourly token profile so our infra team can size the VPC and estimate costs. High-level background: Helix will run a clinician-assist workflow that sends clinical notes (avg 1.2k chars) and asks for structured suggestions; responses will include short summaries + 3 itemized recommendations.

Quick answers from our side:
- Expected pilot duration: 6 weeks
- Estimated concurrent users: 80 peak (internal clinicians)
- Typical turnaround target: 400–700 ms P95 for the UI flow
- Latency budget for model inference: 350 ms P95
- We anticipate spike windows during morning rounds (07:00–09:30 local)

Ask: can you propose a 2–3 model shortlist (including token/context recommendations) and a sample hourly token profile (avg/peak) we can use for capacity planning? Also please attach any simple XLS you use for token scenarios.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Song
Head of Product, Helix Health

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Song <esong@helixhealth.com>, Jacob Reed <jreed@helixhealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 16:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: model shortlist guidance + traffic signal

Emily —

Appreciate the context. Attached is a short token-scenarios sheet and a concise model slate plus operational notes. Summary below — happy to walk through live tomorrow.

Model shortlist (pilot-ready):
1) redwood/serve-7b-q4f16 (recommended default)
   - Latency sweet spot for 350 ms P95 on A100 80GB with continuous batching turned on for our Dedicated offering.
   - Good instruction-following for clinical summarization, robust to mixed-format notes.
   - Typical inference: input 500 tokens / output 160 tokens (estimate).
2) open/xl-13b-chat-32k (context variant)
   - Use if you need longer context recall (full visit history) — supports up to 32k tokens.
   - Higher cost and latency; reserve for threads that require multi-note reasoning.
3) redwood/opt-lite-3b (fallback)
   - Low-cost variant for non-critical background suggestions or batch post-processing.

Context & prompt guidance:
- If you send single-visit notes, allocate 4k context; if you plan to include last 6 visits, use 16k or 32k depending on tokenized size.
- We recommend prefix/KV caching for repeated clinician prompts (saves ~30–50% tokens on common UI flows).

Token profile — conservative sample (per-hour) based on your concurrency note (80 peak clinicians):
- Avg requests per clinician per hour: 1.2 (interactive use) => ~96 req/hr baseline
- Avg tokens per request (prompt+resp): 660 tokens => baseline ~63,360 tokens/hr
- Peak multiplier in morning rounds x4 => peak ~253,440 tokens/hr
- Monthly pilot (6 weeks) rough: assume 12 hours/day active * 7 days * 6 weeks ~ 504 hours; using a blended avg of 120k tokens/hr -> ~60.5M tokens for pilot (rough).

Sizing notes:
- To hit 350 ms P95 we recommend starting with Dedicated pool of 2 x A100-80GB for the default 7B path with autoscale bursts to 3 instances for morning spikes.
- If you choose 13B 32k path, add one additional GPU or accept higher P95 (~700–900 ms).
- We'll enable prefix caching on the routes where clinician context repeats.

Attachments: Pilot_Token_Scenarios.xlsx (breakdowns: per-hour scenarios, qps smoothing, cost estimates), model-shortlist-summary.pdf

Next steps: 1) confirm whether longer context (multi-visit) is required in pilot; 2) share realistic peak hours in your timezone so we can simulate; 3) propose a 45-min sizing sync (we have availability tomorrow 10–11am PT).

— Diego
Diego Fernández
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: model shortlist guidance + traffic signal

Emily / team —

Thanks Diego — that spreadsheet is exactly the kind of input our onboarding ops team needs. Two quick clarifying asks from the implementation side:

1) Can you confirm SLA expectations beyond latency? Specifically: uptime window for pilot (we usually recommend 99.5% for pilot) and acceptable error/retry behavior.
2) Peak profile detail — Diego's peak multiplier is helpful; can you confirm if morning peaks last ~2.5 hours or are they short bursts (15–30 minutes)? This affects how we recommend autoscale windows vs. scheduled bursts.

Implementation checklist notes I want to call out:
- Route definitions: we should map clinician UI routes to model variants (e.g., /summarize -> 7B default, /full-review -> 13B 32k)
- Logging and eval hooks: please enable token-level logging and attach a small prompt set for quality monitoring (we can add regression alerts).
- Security: we'll include SOC2 scoping questions in the same thread (separate doc).

If you can answer 1/2 above we can finalize the capacity recommendation and draft the Dedicated sizing order.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

> Emily / team —
>
> Thanks Diego — that spreadsheet is exactly the kind of input our onboarding ops team needs. Two quick clarifying asks from the implementation side:

Thanks all — quick answers:
- Morning peaks are concentrated: roughly 07:00–08:30 local (about 90 minutes) with two 15-minute microbursts inside that window. Outside the morning window usage is low.
- Uptime: we expect vendor SLAs for the pilot to align with internal tooling — target 99% for pilot is acceptable.

A couple of additional details:
- We will not send full 6-visit history in the pilot; plan is single-visit + last note context (so 4k–8k effective tokens).
- We can start with the 7B default and only route 5–10% of requests to the 13B variant for edge cases.

Can you set up the sizing sync for tomorrow at 10am PT? Emily and I will join.

— Jacob
Jacob Reed
Product Ops, Helix Health

Perfect — thanks for the clarifications. Meeting confirmed: 2026-06-18 10:00am PT (we'll send calendar invite).

Updated quick sizing recommendation (pilot):
- Start: Dedicated 2 x A100-80GB targeted for redwood/serve-7b-q4f16 routes with configured continuous batching and prefix cache.
- Scheduled burst window: autoscale to 3 GPUs for 07:00–09:30 PT (90 min) with short micro-burst allowance for the two 15-min spikes.
- Route policy: /summarize -> 7B (95%), /review -> 13B-32k (5% initially)
- Logging: enable per-token logs + attach a 40-example prompt set for baseline quality checks.

Action items:
1) Diego to send XLS + cost ballpark (attached).
2) Monica to share onboarding playbook and SOC2 checklist link after sync.
3) Helix to provide final list of routes to map (deadline: EOD Friday).

See you at 10am PT — invite incoming.
